notes: Packet text_source captions_plus_linked_text. Linked-text blocks are shifted: the F4 block carries the paper's Fig. 5 paragraphs (XPS, TRPL, EIS, Qst) and is truncated mid-sentence ('The peak intensity of HCOO- for'); the F5 block carries the Fig. 6 DFT paragraphs, and paper Fig. 6 is absent from the packet. EIS/photocurrent (Fig. S17), band positions (Fig. S18), isotherms (Fig. S19) and the CR-H DRIFTS (Fig. S13) are text-only and are listed in requires_unseen. Audits: a1 (EXAFS first shell coincides with Cu-O references, qualifies the Cu-S interface), a2 (Qst crossover, text-silent), lim1 (PL lifetime reasoning). o24 (text-silent) shows CR-H above CuCR SCC in CH4 yield at 2.0-3.5 h against the text's 'better CH4'. Caption F2f says low-temperature EPR; the linked text says the g = 2.08 signal was taken at room temperature. Schematics F2e, F4e, F5g and the FFT F1f were opened with their figures but not cited. Branches: s4 -> r1 (charge transfer) and s3 -> r2 (CO2 binding) meet in m1; s4 -> f2 (stability) is a side branch into the conclusion, off the spine after judge review.
